useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin --home-dir /var/lib/inventory inventory-worker; mkdir -p /var/lib/inventory; chown inventory-worker:inventory-worker /var/lib/inventory; chmod 750 /var/lib/inventory; id inventory-worker

mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/inventory-worker
cat > /usr/local/lib/inventory-worker/worker.sh <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
STATE_DIR="/var/lib/inventory"
LOG_FILE="$STATE_DIR/worker.log"
COUNT_FILE="$STATE_DIR/count"

[ -f "$COUNT_FILE" ] || echo 0 > "$COUNT_FILE"

while true; do
  n=$(cat "$COUNT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  n=$((n + 1))
  echo "$n" > "$COUNT_FILE"
  printf '%s tick=%s\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$n" >> "$LOG_FILE"
  sleep 10
done
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/lib/inventory-worker/worker.sh
cat /usr/local/lib/inventory-worker/worker.sh

commands.command:
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory background worker
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/local/lib/inventory-worker/worker.sh
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

User=inventory-worker
Group=inventory-worker

NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
PrivateDevices=yes
ProtectKernelTunables=yes
ProtectKernelModules=yes
ProtectKernelLogs=yes
ProtectControlGroups=yes
ProtectClock=yes
ProtectHostname=yes
RestrictSUIDSGID=yes
RestrictNamespaces=yes
RestrictRealtime=yes
LockPersonality=yes
MemoryDenyWriteExecute=yes
RemoveIPC=yes
CapabilityBoundingSet=
AmbientCapabilities=
UMask=0027
SystemCallFilter=@system-service
SystemCallErrorNumber=EPERM

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
ANTRIEB_EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemd-analyze verify inventory-worker.service; echo verify_exit=$?
systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service; sleep 2; systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager -l
